task_title: Move the Floor 2 / chain win-rate investigation into the release workflow

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.4) before any code was written. (1) Blocking: a stable (non-commit) marker plus per-SHA-only job serialization lets two overlapping releases each create an issue -- adopted: the filer now sorts open marker matches by issue number, updates the lowest-numbered canonical issue, and closes the rest as superseded, with a unit test. (2) Blocking: skipping a missing monitored leg would silently retire the check on a publisher bug or leg rename -- adopted: monitored leg ids are derived from RELEASE_SWEEP_LEGS (non-blocking legs) instead of a second hardcoded copy, and a leg missing from a baseline captured under the current RELEASE_SWEEP_REVISION throws; older revisions are still skipped as history. (3) The plan undercounted test churn from deleting buildWinRateInvestigationClause -- adopted: the nightly-balance tests were pruned/updated and re-run (36 node --test cases green). (4) Dual-output plumbing needs CLI-level coverage, not just pure-function tests -- adopted: a spawn-based CLI test asserts both result files and both GITHUB_OUTPUT keys on a release where Floor 1 also lost runs. (5) Do not lose threshold provenance when moving the 0.9 constant -- adopted: ci-config-knobs.md row rewritten to point at the new location and the now-dead entry removed from the ci-knobs-guard allowlist. Reviewer confirmed the one-script/two-results shape and the report-only (non-blocking) reading of the maintainer intent were correct.

rounds.notes: code_review tool reviewed all 13 changed files and returned no comments. The plan-review concerns (duplicate-issue race, fail-closed missing leg, CLI coverage, knob provenance) had already been folded in before this round.
